en.headline: Four elderly-home residents carrying resistant bacteria
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a cluster at a Southern District care home after hospital screening found four residents carrying the bacteria.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a cluster of carbapenemase-producing Enterobacteriaceae carriage at a residential care home for the elderly in the Southern District, involving four residents on the same floor.

The centre said it was notified by the Hospital Authority after the four residents were admitted to public hospitals for their own illnesses. Screening samples taken on admission later confirmed they were carrying the bacteria, and officials suspect they acquired it at the home. The patients, two men and two women aged 69 to 99, have not shown symptoms linked to infection and are in stable condition, the centre said.

Epidemiological checks pointed to two earlier known carriers on the same floor as a possible source. After inspecting the home, the centre said infection-control measures had not been properly followed, and that spread through staff or contaminated surfaces and objects could not be ruled out. Staff have been told to follow the official guidelines, including correct use of protective equipment, hand hygiene, and thorough cleaning. The centre has also advised grouping carriers in one area.

Screening at the home is continuing to look for other carriers, and medical surveillance of the home will go on. The centre said the bacteria can resist carbapenem and other beta-lactam antibiotics, which limits treatment options if infection develops, although carriers may have no symptoms.

zh.headline: 南區安老院四名院友帶有抗藥性腸道桿菌
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心正調查南區一間安老院的帶菌群組，四名同層院友入院篩查證實帶有產碳青霉烯酶腸道桿菌，暫無相關病徵。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心正調查一宗產碳青霉烯酶腸道桿菌帶菌群組，涉及南區一間安老院同一樓層的四名院友。
中心表示，近日接獲醫院管理局通知，四名院友因自身疾病在公立醫院留醫，入院篩查樣本其後證實帶菌，懷疑在安老院受到感染。四名病人為兩男兩女，年齡介乎69至99歲，均沒有出現相關感染病徵，情況穩定。
流行病學調查顯示，感染源頭可能來自同一樓層早前已知的另外兩名帶菌者。中心人員巡查後發現院舍未有妥善執行傳染病預防及控制措施，不排除細菌經員工，或受污染的環境和物品在院內傳播。中心已提醒職員跟從安老院預防傳染病指引，包括正確穿戴和卸除個人防護裝備、加強手部衞生，以及徹底清潔消毒，並建議把帶菌者集中安置。
中心會繼續在院舍篩查，以確定有否其他帶菌者，並對安老院進行醫學監察。中心指出，這類細菌可令碳青霉烯類及其他β-內酰胺抗生素失效，一旦引起感染會限制治療選擇，但帶菌者可以沒有病徵。
